PMJAY.description: Cashless family-floater health cover of Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization at empanelled public and private hospitals across India.
PMJAY.user_friendly_description: Up to Rs 5 lakh a year in free hospital treatment for your whole family, with no cash needed upfront.

PMJAY.description: Covers 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses including diagnostics and medicines.
PMJAY.user_friendly_description: Tests and medicines just before and for 15 days after your hospital stay are also covered.

PMJAY.description: No restriction on family size, age, or gender; benefit is a family floater.
PMJAY.user_friendly_description: Every member of your family can use the same yearly amount - there's no per-person cap.

PMJAY.description: All pre-existing diseases are covered from day one of enrolment, with no waiting period.
PMJAY.user_friendly_description: Illnesses you already had before joining are covered immediately - no waiting period.

PMJAY.description: Benefits are portable nationwide - a beneficiary can use any empanelled hospital in any state, not only their home state.
PMJAY.user_friendly_description: You can get treated at any empanelled hospital anywhere in India, even outside your home state.

PMJAY.description: Approximately 1,929 treatment packages (per nha.gov.in) across roughly 24 medical specialities are covered; exact current package count is periodically revised (HBP versions) and should be reconfirmed.
PMJAY.user_friendly_description: Around 1,900+ different treatments and procedures are covered, from surgeries to cancer care - though the exact number changes over time as it's updated.

VAYVANDANA.description: Rs. 5,00,000 per year free health cover for the senior citizen (70+), irrespective of socio-economic status.
VAYVANDANA.user_friendly_description: Up to Rs 5 lakh a year in free hospital treatment for the senior citizen, no matter their income.

VAYVANDANA.description: If the senior citizen's family is already a PM-JAY beneficiary family, an ADDITIONAL top-up of up to Rs. 5,00,000/year is provided exclusively for the 70+ member(s), separate from and not shared with the family's existing PM-JAY cover.
VAYVANDANA.user_friendly_description: If your family already has PM-JAY, the 70+ family member gets an EXTRA Rs 5 lakh just for themselves, on top of the family's existing cover.

VAYVANDANA.description: Coverage for approximately 1,900-2,000+ medical/surgical procedures across roughly 27 specialities per government press statements (exact figure varies slightly by source/date).
VAYVANDANA.user_friendly_description: Covers a very wide range of treatments and surgeries across most medical specialities.

CGHS.description: OPD treatment and medicine issue at CGHS Wellness Centres.
CGHS.user_friendly_description: Free outpatient doctor visits and medicines at CGHS centres.

CGHS.description: Specialist consultation at government hospitals, and at CGHS empanelled hospitals after referral.
CGHS.user_friendly_description: Access to specialist doctors at government hospitals, with referrals to empanelled private hospitals when needed.

CGHS.description: Hospitalization (indoor treatment) at government and CGHS-empanelled private hospitals.
CGHS.user_friendly_description: Hospital admission and treatment at government or CGHS-approved private hospitals.

CGHS.description: Investigations/diagnostics at government and empanelled diagnostic centres.
CGHS.user_friendly_description: Lab tests and scans at government or CGHS-approved diagnostic centres.

CGHS.description: Reimbursement for hearing aids, artificial limbs, and similar appliances/implants as per CGHS ceiling rates and guidelines.
CGHS.user_friendly_description: Money back for things like hearing aids and artificial limbs, up to set limits.

CGHS.description: Coverage across Allopathic, Homoeopathic, and Indian systems of medicine (Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Yoga/AYUSH).
CGHS.user_friendly_description: You can choose modern medicine or traditional Indian systems like Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, or Yoga-based treatment.

CGHS.description: In emergencies, beneficiaries may go to any hospital (empanelled or not) and later claim reimbursement for treatment at private unrecognized hospitals under emergency conditions.
CGHS.user_friendly_description: In a real emergency, you can go to the nearest hospital even if it isn't on the approved list, and claim the cost back later.

ESIC.description: Medical care for the insured person and dependents at ESIC hospitals/dispensaries.
ESIC.user_friendly_description: Free or subsidised medical treatment for you and your dependents at ESIC facilities.

ESIC.description: Statutory cash benefits: sickness benefit, maternity benefit, disablement benefit, and dependents' benefit (in case of employment-related death), funded through employer-employee contributions (0.75% employee / 3.25% employer of gross wages).
ESIC.user_friendly_description: Cash support if you're sick, having a baby, injured at work, or in case of an employment-related death in the family - funded by small automatic deductions from pay plus your employer's contribution.

CMCHIS.description: Cashless family-floater health insurance cover of Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year at empanelled government and private hospitals in Tamil Nadu, for the current 2022-2027 implementation cycle.
CMCHIS.user_friendly_description: Up to Rs 5 lakh a year in free hospital treatment for your family at approved Tamil Nadu hospitals.

CMCHIS.description: Covers surgeries, follow-up treatments, and diagnostic procedures - reported as approximately 1,090 procedures, 8 follow-up procedures, and 52 diagnostic procedures as of a January 2022 reference point.
CMCHIS.user_friendly_description: Covers a wide range of surgeries, follow-up care, and diagnostic tests - though the exact numbers may have changed since 2022.

CMCHIS.description: A proposed enhancement of coverage to Rs. 25,00,000 per family has been publicly announced; implementation status (in force vs. pending official guidelines) is unconfirmed.
CMCHIS.user_friendly_description: There's been a government announcement about raising the cover to Rs 25 lakh, but it's unclear if this is actually active yet - do not assume this higher amount without checking.
